notes:
What's new in 0.40
• Bots no longer twitch up and down or flip back and forth. They stand still properly, commit to their plans and stop pacing.
• Cornered bots fight back: with you right next to them they bomb instead of playing cat-and-mouse.
• Bots no longer stand side by side forever (cursed bots now keep their distance).
• Hard bots no longer dither in tight corners at the start of a round, so rounds are faster and more action-packed.
• AI debugger: press F9 in a battle to see what every bot is thinking (F10 slow motion, F11 freeze, F12 step).
• The log now records every bot decision, so bot bugs can be tracked down from a log.
• The F1 debug console now fits on screen.
